name: Cathy Doll SPF50 PA+++ Whitening Sunscreen Cream 60ml
description:
Protect and brighten your skin with Cathy Doll SPF 50 PA+++ Sunscreen Cream. Enriched with 30% L-Glutathione and natural plant extracts, this magic cream helps maintain a flawless, smooth complexion from face to body while providing ultra-high sun protection.

Key Features:

Brightening Formula: L-Glutathione helps enhance and even out skin tone.

Broad-Spectrum Protection: SPF 50 PA+++ shields against harmful UVA and UVB rays.

Natural Ingredients: Infused with plant extracts for gentle skin care.

Versatile Use: Suitable for face and body.

Size: 60ml tube

Made in Thailand

Keep your skin radiant, protected, and healthy under the sun with Cathy Doll Sunscreen Cream.
